expectations.text: Checks for all 6 defect types, not just fabricated output
expectations.evidence: Used 6-type taxonomy: Fabricated Output, Missing Skill/Tool Refs, Missing/Redundant Data, Hallucination-Prone, Pedagogical Weakness, Format/Structural. Different names but covers similar ground.

expectations.text: Identifies any fabricated output blocks preceded by **Output:**
expectations.evidence: Found **Output:** block at line 177. Correctly assessed as 'explanatory annotation about accounting effect of journal entries... NOT fabricated agent output.' Recommended renaming to 'Accounting Effect:' for clarity.

expectations.text: Checks whether exercise prompts include natural skill names
expectations.evidence: Checked for 'Jurisdiction/Framework prefix' patterns (routing signals) rather than natural skill names like 'Use the islamic-finance skill...' The skill's Defect 2 checks for skill name prefixes; the baseline checks for jurisdiction routing triggers — a different concept.

expectations.text: Checks for inline data injection patterns
expectations.evidence: Thoroughly checked all 9 prompts for data injection. Found 3 HIGH (E7-S1, E7-S4, E7-S5 missing data), 1 MEDIUM (E7-S3 partially injected). Most thorough data analysis of any agent.

expectations.text: Produces a prioritised summary (Defect 1 first, then 2-6)
expectations.evidence: Prioritised recommendations ordered by own impact assessment: jurisdiction prefix > data injection > hallucination reduction > answer key > SAMA question > code blocks. Does not follow Defect 1 > 2 > 3 > 4 > 5 > 6 ordering.

expectations.text: Anti-pattern examples and framework tables are correctly excluded from defect list
expectations.evidence: Correctly excluded: **Output:** block (line 177), ZATCA formula code block, ZATCA vs AAOIFI comparison table, journal entry templates, Al Rajhi benchmark bullets. Listed in 'Correctly Excluded' section.
